system.description:
No mortal can match you, and even vampires flinch at your touch; the strength in your dead limbs is monumental, crushing whatever stands before you.

With Puissance you win all ties in tests of strength automatically, without comparing Traits at all, unless some other factor would cost you the tie (such as wounds) or grant the opponent the same all-ties advantage (such as Fleetness). In addition, your strikes inflict one extra health level of damage in any combat where your strength is a factor — unarmed or with melee weapons — though such force almost always shatters any weapon not specially built to withstand it.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
